task: league-schedule-generator (flagship 9): three-session wait-free designs at 40 and 46 teams

errors.what: First `git checkout -b` failed because the harness had already created the branch; the claim commit still landed on it (piped `tail` hid the exit code).
python-sat was installed for /usr/local/bin/python3 3.13 but a later `python3` in another cwd resolved to a different interpreter without it; reinstalling with `python3 -m pip` fixed it.

doc_friction.issue: It rewrites session-designs.mjs from a list of solver JSON files, but those files are not kept in the tree, so adding one design would have dropped the 32 stored ones; added --append.
Printed 'HOLD' with exit 1 while its own message said no older PR claimed the item; unclear whether HOLD meant stop. Proceeded since no competing PR was named.

deviations.why: The first item, 29 teams on 5x9, had just absorbed a full run that proved the established method cannot work and left hours-long SAT runs as the remaining route; the second item (3-session designs at 14, 38, 40, 46) was tractable with the same group idea.
deviations.did: Took the second item: 40 and 46 (14 and 38 already reach 0 waits without designs).
deviations.result: Both solved in 0.1 s; 794 and 1,201 waits to 0.

notes: eval/session-orbit.py: n = 3k+1, k odd; g = +3 mod 3k fixing one team has order k with every pair orbit of size k, 3n/2 orbits = one night of three rounds. SAT on one night (10k vars) solves 40 (7 courts) and 46 (8 courts) in 0.1 s each (repeated 3x); also 22, 28, 34, 52, 58, 64 (not stored beyond 48). Season builds with designs: 40 teams 794 waits -> 0, 18.5 s -> 1.5 s; 46 teams 1,201 -> 0, 11.8 s -> 2.1 s (seeds 1-3). node --test doubleheader.test.mjs: 33/33 pass. Full eval/three-game-nights.mjs rerun: Part 5 40 and 46 teams now 'yes | 794 | 0' and 'yes | 1201 | 0', no invalid season; the rerun overwrote a hand-kept 'Part 7 before' block, restored by hand. run_venture_tests.py league-schedule-generator: ok, 555 tests, 208 s.
